product: REA Backup native restic repository slice
method: New source-assisted Node implementation; authenticated released original executable used only as an independent test oracle, never as app runtime

baseline.authentication: Each oracle fixture hashes preserved release ZIP and executable, copies executable bytes into its own temporary directory, hashes that copy, then verifies exact restic version and Go compiler version before further execution. No shared oracle directory mutation.
baseline.exactOriginalVersion: restic 0.19.1 compiled with go1.26.4 on windows/amd64

validation.browserValidation: Not performed by this agent; no shared browser or actual user credential was used.
validation.scope: Full 34-test run after native timestamp correction and before the separately authorized custom-format restore timestamp correction. These exact tested hashes must not be attributed to subsequent custom source changes.

observedContracts: Native app-generated v1 and v2 key/config/repositories opened by original CLI
Original check --read-data passes for app-generated v1/v2 initial and repeated snapshots and app appends to original repositories
Original restores app-generated v1/v2 snapshots with matching binary/Unicode/empty-file bytes and empty directories
Original-generated v1/v2 snapshots are listed, inspected, verified, restored and extended by the app
Original v2 fixture asserted compressed metadata encoding 2 and nonzero compressed pack blob lengths, not just a v2 label
Native whole storage SHA-256, plaintext SHA-256, authenticated pack header/index agreement and file lengths verified
Wrong password, altered key/config/snapshot/payload/header MAC, invalid header type/footer length/index offset and plaintext hash rejected
Original CLI independently rejects altered config authentication and recognizes app-generated exclusive lock bytes
Authenticated unsafe traversal/case-collision/duplicate/unordered/symlink/oversize/content-length tree fixtures rejected before output creation
Excessive KDF parameters and zstd output expansion rejected
Input traversal, overlapping folders, short IDs, unconfirmed restore and every existing repository/restore destination rejected
Existing destination bytes remain intact after rejected restore
Existing and stale locks are refused without deleting them; normal app locks are released
Oversized or concurrently changed source aborts snapshot publication; source-change test begins after a real pack has been published and documents remaining unreferenced packs
Native HTTP init/snapshot/list/check/restore survives host restart; app records remain empty and API responses contain no request password
Existing custom snapshot/chunk/retention/restore and HTTP restart tests pass unchanged
Fourteen authenticated malformed node mtime/atime/ctime fixtures reject before native restore output; original check --read-data exits nonzero, sometimes by panic
Five authenticated malformed snapshot-time fixtures reject in native listing and selected inspection/check/restore before output; original check --read-data exits nonzero
Seventeen valid timestamp boundary fixtures pass native and original verification, including year 0000/9999, null zero time, 19-digit/comma fractions, single-digit hours and offsets +24:00/+00:60
Thirteen supported-Windows file-time boundary fixtures and one null-snapshot-time fixture restore with matching bytes and represented mtime within one millisecond using both app and original
Four valid-restic but unsupported-Windows file-time fixtures are inspectable/verifiable and refused by native restore before destination creation
Snapshot listing orders actual timestamp instants across timezone offsets; all app-owned locks are released after these fixtures

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Original calibrated scrypt p=12 exceeded initial p<=8 guard
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Allow p<=64 while preserving explicit N*r memory and N*r*p work budgets

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Original local repositories omit optional tmp directory
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Do not require tmp on open; create it safely when atomically writing

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Index-only corruption test helper tried exclusive write of unchanged pack bytes
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Preserve existing identical pack when only index changes; corrected helper then exercised actual index/header mismatch

failuresAndCorrections.failure: No failing test; aggregate decoded metadata/tree budget, write/read depth boundary and lock acquisition cleanup needed stronger explicit enforcement
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Count stored plus decoded metadata and repeated tree expansion, validate generated tree before publication, align source depth, and include second lock check in cleanup scope

failuresAndCorrections.failure: PowerShell hash-output pipeline syntax failed before hashes/checks executed
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Collected hash records before piping; final hash, client syntax and whitespace checks passed

failuresAndCorrections.failure: JavaScript Date.parse coerced numeric time and normalized invalid calendars; selected snapshot reads omitted time validation
failuresAndCorrections.correction: New bounded Go-compatible parser shared by snapshot listing/selection and optional node mtime/atime/ctime validation; preserve safely supported original extensions and null zero time

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Test assumed original snapshots --json returns nonzero for malformed metadata, but original warns/skips and can return success
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Compare malformed timestamp rejection with original check --read-data instead

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Original malformed tree may panic with tree was not read completely rather than a direct time parse diagnostic
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Explicitly record and accept the observed nonzero panic outcome as original rejection, without claiming graceful handling

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Node 24.16.0 utimes silently wraps negative and overflowing unsigned 32-bit Unix seconds
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Native Windows restore preflights all requested mtimes before output and reads each applied time back within one millisecond; wider valid restic times stay readable but restore is refused

boundaries: Only bounded workspace-local restic repositories; no remote backend or original runtime wrapper
Writer fixed 1 MiB data blobs, one blob per pack and uncompressed v1/v2 metadata/data; no Rabin/batching/randomization/compression policy parity
Writer fixed scrypt N=32768,r=8,p=1 differs from original calibration and may reduce password-guessing resistance
BigInt Poly1305 arithmetic has no constant-time guarantee and no cryptographic audit; no original-grade production security claim
Snapshot paths are logical /source-name paths, not original absolute-path construction; custom format remains separately plaintext
Regular Unicode files/directories and millisecond modification times only; no symlink/device/sparse/ownership/ACL/xattr/hardlink/mode restoration or nanosecond parity
Selected snapshot verification, not whole-repository check/repair/orphan reclamation
No native retention/prune, repair, key management, mount, scheduler, cancellation, lock refresh or automatic stale-lock removal
Application budgets and cooperative deadline are not OS CPU/memory isolation
Trusted local filesystem required; repeated workspace path checks do not eliminate adversarial concurrent symlink/reparse replacement races
Crash/init/write failures may leave partial new repositories, temporary files, stale own locks or unreferenced packs; no published snapshot references intentionally missing data
No superiority, full replacement, universal format acceptance or exact original chunk/tree identity established
Timestamp parser accepts at most 128 characters and Go-compatible permissive forms; conversion and list ordering have millisecond precision, not exact nanosecond ordering

On tested Windows Node runtime, restore modification times are limited to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z through 2106-02-07T06:28:15.999Z; null/year-0000/year-9999 file times are refused before output despite being valid restic metadata

independentReview.scope: Separate read-only reviewer verified pinned sources, 176 AES/raw-Poly1305 vectors, 19 original timestamp boundary acceptance cases, three malformed metadata pre-output rejection reproductions and timezone ordering. One confirmed timestamp-family finding was corrected and independently retested; zero unresolved confirmed findings in that reviewed scope. This is not a cryptographic security audit or full product comparison.
